links.passage: These indices can be used to identify areas of the crop that are affected by pests or diseases, which can help farmers to take action to prevent further damage.
supporting_passages: In addition to the commonly used vegetation indices, such as NDVI (Normalized Differential Vegetation Index), EVI (Enhanced Vegetation Index), NDWI (Normalized Differential Water Index), and LAI (Leaf Area Index), other indices have been proposed for pest and disease detection, such as the Disease Water Stress Index (DWSI) (Apan et al. 2004), Disease Index (DI) (Zheng et al., 2018), Yellow Rust Index (YRI) (Huang et al. 2014), Aphid Index (AI) (Luo et al. 2013), and Leafhopper Index (LHI) (Prabhakar et al. 2011).
These indices can be used to identify areas of the crop that are affected by pests or diseases, which can help farmers to take action to prevent further damage.
links.inference_note: The cited sentence names remote-sensing vegetation indices for pest and disease detection, and the following sentence states that these indices help farmers take action to prevent further pest and disease damage.
